meta.name: to-issues
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or PRD into independently-grabbable issues on the project issue tracker using tracer-bullet vertical slices. Use when user wants to convert a plan into issues, create implementation tickets, or break down work into issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将计划或需求拆解为可独立领取的议题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把一份计划或PRD拆成可执行的开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Break a plan or PRD into independently-grabbable issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to convert a plan or PRD into actionable development tasks

howto.what: Claude 会把你的计划、规格或产品需求文档拆分成多个独立可领取的 issue，每个 issue 是一个贯穿所有层的垂直切片，完成后可演示或验证。
howto.when: 当你要求将计划转换为 issue、创建实现工单或分解工作时触发。

say.text: 把这个 PRD 拆成可领取的 issue。
say.note: Claude 会分析 PRD 并生成垂直切片列表。

say.text: 把这份计划分解成 tracer bullet issue。
say.note: Claude 会按依赖顺序创建 issue。

howto.what_en: Claude breaks your plan, spec, or PRD into independently-grabbable issues, each being a thin vertical slice through all layers, demoable or verifiable on its own.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert a plan into issues, create implementation tickets, or break down work.

say_en.text: Break this PRD into grabable issues.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the PRD and generate a list of vertical slices.

say_en.text: Decompose this plan into tracer bullet issues.
say_en.note: Claude will create issues in dependency order.
